meta.author: farbrausch
meta.description: zeitmaschine (fr_public v2/v2m) by farbrausch, a Farbrausch V2 song (.v2m format version 6) taken from farbrausch's fr_public repository (`v2/v2m/v2_zeitmaschine_new.v2m`). The same file is also at fr_public/v2__v2m__v2_zeitmaschine_new.v2m in the local corpus. 120 BPM, 2:48, 16 tracks. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: converted by `synth-convert v2m` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64) and imported with `song import`. Against the v2redux reference render it differs by +0.02 dB loudness and at most -0.49 @ 125 Hz in any octave band (tools/unisynth-parity, A/B listening approved 2026-10-28). No licence is stated: the music belongs to its authors. It is published here as an adapted reference copy while its authors are asked for permission, and is removed at any author's request.
